<p align="center"><strong>Ending 05 of 06 - All Souls Home</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Star lantern &middot; Sky bearing &middot; Beacon restored</small></p>


<p align="center">You lead the lights through the northern pines. At each turning, a name leaves you for a house in town. Curtains stir. Someone remembers who they are.</p>

<p align="center">The last two lights are Elias and Ada. They fade together where the forest ends.</p>

<p align="center">At dawn, Briar House is an empty plot again. You post the caretaker's warning on the town noticeboard and keep the key. Next October, you will return before anyone knocks.</p>

<p align="center">ALL SOULS HOME - Every stolen name is free. The curse is held shut, and this time the town knows what waits behind the door.</p>
